description: Rung 1 of plan v5: equal-weight top 15 by a fixed five-factor composite, with liquidity filter, sector and earnings caps, entry/exit bands. No regime dial, no optimizer, no options. v1.1: volatility premium weight set to 0 after the drop-one-factor audit (see docs/AUDIT.md).
